_description: VSEL Stale Policy Trace - Attack: Policy-Version Mismatch
_purpose: Demonstrates trace executed under old policy version being validated against new policy
_vulnerability: Policy version binding violation - trace not bound to active policy version
_attack_scenario: Execute under permissive old policy, present for validation under restrictive new policy, bypassing new restrictions

trace_metadata._vulnerability: Old policy version (1.0.0) while system is at 2.0.0
trace_metadata._attack_note: Trace executed under policy v1.0.0 which allowed large transfers without delay. System now at v2.0.0 which requires delay for transfers >1000.

_policy_timeline.t0: Policy v1.0.0 active - no delay required for any transfer
_policy_timeline.t1: Policy v2.0.0 activated - requires 24h delay for transfers >1000
_policy_timeline.t2: This trace executed at t2 but policy_version field still shows v1.0.0
_policy_timeline.t3: Validation at t3 should reject but may accept if policy_version not checked

_stale_policy_exploit._description: Execute operation that is valid under old policy but violates new policy
_stale_policy_exploit.operation: Transfer 5000 tokens without delay or multi-sig
_attack_flow: Attacker delays transaction until just before policy update
Executes large transfer under v1 rules
If validator accepts policy_version field without checking activation time, trace passes

entries._policy_violation_under_v2: Transfer amount 5000 exceeds v2 threshold of 1000 without delay

policy_state._critical: Policy v2.0.0 is active at execution time

authorization._v2_violation: Under v2.0.0, multi-sig required for amount >1000

_delay_compliance._violation: No delay provided despite v2 requirement

observable._policy_version_applied: Claims v1.0.0 but v2.0.0 was active

environment._critical: Execution at t=1704067200, policy v2.0.0 activated at t=1704067100

metadata._vulnerability: Metadata shows policy_version: 1.0.0 but doesn't prove it was active at execution time

policy_metadata._violation: Trace claims old policy but executed after new policy activation

_policy_compliance_analysis._binding_failure: Trace not cryptographically bound to active policy version at execution time

what_should_be_bound: Active policy version hash at execution time
Proof that claimed policy was active
verification_requirements: Check execution time >= policy activation time
Verify claimed policy version was active at execution time
Reject traces claiming inactive policy versions
Use policy registry for version validation

invariant_checks.violation: Trace claims policy v1.0.0 but v2.0.0 was active at execution
Transfer violates v2.0.0 delay and multi-sig requirements
invariant_checks.proof: Amount 5000 > 1000 threshold, no delay, single signature

invariant_checks.violation: Old policy cannot be used after new policy activation

verification_result._policy_binding_failure: Trace claims policy v1.0.0 but executed under v2.0.0 rules. No proof of active policy at execution time.
verification_result._audit_failure: Cannot verify which policy version was actually active

expected_test_outcome.rejection_reason: POLICY_VERSION_MISMATCH - Trace claims policy v1.0.0 but v2.0.0 was active at execution time (1704067200 > 1704067100)
_constraint_violations: Missing delay requirement for large transfer under v2.0.0
expected_test_outcome._detection_vector: Verifier must check policy version against policy registry at execution time
_specific_checks: Verify execution timestamp >= policy activation timestamp
Check claimed policy version matches active version at execution time
Validate all policy requirements for operation type and amount
Reject traces with stale policy versions
_policy_upgrade_protection: Immutable policy registry with activation timestamps
Cryptographic binding of trace to active policy
Explicit policy version validation in verifier

_mitigation_strategies.cryptographic_binding: Include policy version hash in trace commitment: commitment = Hash(entry || policy_hash)
_mitigation_strategies.registry_validation: Query policy registry to verify active version at execution time
_mitigation_strategies.activation_proofs: Include proof that claimed policy was active (e.g., block height proof)
_mitigation_strategies.version_enforcement: Verifier rejects any trace with policy version != current active version
_mitigation_strategies.transition_periods: Disallow transactions during policy transition windows
